backgroundFill.description: A string becomes the background color, so any CSS color or gradient works. A node is rendered full-bleed behind the content, and an img or video inside it is scaled to cover the section.

captionText.description: Supporting copy rendered below the headline.

darkeningMask.description: Adds a solid layer over the background. Pair it with darkeningMaskOpacity, which is 0 by default.

darkeningMaskOpacity.description: The opacity of that layer, from 0 to 1.

darkeningVignette.description: Draws a 40px gradient along the top edge, above the content, so a transparent header navigation stays legible.

hasInvertTextColor.description: Sets the headline and caption in the light text color, for a hero over a dark backdrop: imagery, or a darkening mask over it. The color is the same in both themes, because the backdrop it is read against is.

headerFontSize.description: The type scale of the headline.

headerText.description: The headline. Rendered as an h1 and omitted entirely when not provided.

heroHeight.description: Any CSS height. Below a 512px viewport it is ignored and the section falls back to fit-content.

overlayContainerMinMargin.description: Overrides the side padding at each breakpoint. The value is written straight into CSS, so it needs a unit. The number type in the signature is wrong: a plain number produces an invalid declaration and the side padding drops to zero.
overlayContainerMinMargin.type: { small: number; medium: number; large: number; }

overlayContentWidth.description: Any CSS width for the content block, for example "60%" or "640px".

overlayContentPosition.description: Where the content block sits inside the section. Only visible when the section is taller or wider than the content.

overlayMedia.description: A media layer above the background and independent of the text block. An img or video inside it is scaled to cover the layer.

overlayMediaPosition.description: Where that layer sits inside the section.

overlayMediaMaxHeight.description: Sets the height of the media layer, with the same caveat.

overlayMediaMaxWidth.description: Sets the width of the media layer outright rather than a maximum, despite the name. Without it the layer has no width.

overlayMediaMargin.description: A margin shorthand for the media layer. Pass the object form to vary it by breakpoint: small below md, medium below lg, large above.
overlayMediaMargin.type: string | { small: string; medium: string; large: string; }

textAlignment.description: Aligns the text within the content block, which starts at the leading edge when the prop is unset. This is separate from overlayContentPosition, which moves the block itself.

children.description: Rendered in a full-width slot below the caption. Use it for buttons, links, or a search field.

className.description: Declared so it type-checks, but nothing in the component reads it: it travels with the rest of the props onto the section element.
